name: Nyungwe Forest National Park
story: Nyungwe Forest National Park is located in southwestern Rwanda, covering approximately 1,019 square kilometres of rainforest, bamboo, grassland, swamps, and bogs. Established in 2004, it reaches a maximum altitude of 3,000 metres at Mount Bigugu. It is widely considered the best preserved montane rainforest in Africa.
matters: The park is a priority for conservation in Africa, containing 13 primate species and a high number of restricted-range species found only in the Albertine Rift montane forests ecoregion. It shelters colonies of chimpanzees and Angola colobus.
